'''Garv''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pho Ph'eahian]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] who was a friend of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] during the [[Rebellion era|Dark Times]]. He helped repair the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
